runs.text: The Human Fiction is a philosophical and reflective work.
It does not provide psychological, medical, legal, or professional advice.
All concepts presented are interpretive explorations of perception, identity, and meaning.
They are intended for reflection, not instruction.
This book does not claim absolute truth.
It explores how truth is often constructed through interpretation.
Readers are encouraged to engage independently and critically with the material.
No idea within this book should be treated as final, absolute, or universally applicable.
The author holds no responsibility for personal interpretations or conclusions drawn from this work.
